name: Sergeant Hollis
bio: The single archer who started on the squat tower of Emberhold in Keepfire. Now leads a garrison.

portrait.subject: a cute determined young archer sergeant with a bowl haircut, a dented helmet, a red tabard with a flame emblem and a longbow
portrait.background: stone castle tower at sunset with banners

request: Sergeant Hollis of Emberhold, Keepfire! The keep needs allies. Join us? 🏰
hello: Huzzah! The keep stands stronger already.
Spend gold mid-wave. Waiting costs lives.
about: I'm Hollis. I was the first and only archer on Emberhold's tower. Now we have walls, mages and a whole lot of lanes.
how: Monsters march down five lanes. Spend the gold from each kill on defences mid-wave, and grow the keep between waves.
tips: Balance the lanes. One weak lane loses the keep.
Upgrades between waves stack forever. Invest!
Spend during the wave, not after it.
chat: Shot an arrow so far it landed in next week.
The new mage set his own hat on fire.
A goblin waved at me before charging. Polite.
Emberhold has a cat now. She's on the wall. She's our best scout.
nudge: Monsters on the horizon! Man the walls?
The keep's ready for a bigger fight. You?
idle: Gold's been piling up in the treasury for {ago}, my liege! 💰
{ago}! The keep held. Barely. Come back!
progress: We held to wave {wave}! Next is {wave+1}. Ready the arrows!

questions.q: Which lane do you defend first?

update: Keepfire has been updated to v{version}! New defences?
